description: I would like to convey my sincere gratitude to the voters who expressed their support on both Republican and Democratic ballots on Primary Day.It is critical that property tax relief and a focus on Public Safety receive priority in Montpelier.The policy directives and voting history of our current super majority and representative indicate that these issues are not of importance to them.I will listen to the needs of the residents of St. Albans, support Governor Scott and work across party lines

title: Thank You!
